instruction.text: A double bass is leaning against a chair. The double bass is 122 cm tall. The chair is 93 cm tall. What angle does the double bass make with the chair? Give your answer to two decimal places.
Jared is going down a slide. If the slide is 2.34 m long and 2 m tall, what angle does the slide make with the perpendicular height of the slide? Give your answer to two decimal places.

Some stairs lead from ground level down to a cellar. If the stairs are 5 m long and the cellar is 3 m below ground, what angle do the stairs make with the cellar wall? Give your answer to two decimal places.

Jenny loves skating with her friends. Her favourite ramp is 9 m long and has a height of 5.54 m. What angle does the slope of the ramp make with the perpendicular height of the ramp? Give your answer to two decimal places.
